experiments.CH212: the display's omission and the two ledgers
experiments.CH215: the scheduled end (optional fourth; enters only by its CR9 counts)

k_tests_rule: the tests whose census gate passes (section 7), a subset of [CH213, CH214, CH212] plus CH215 only if ch215.entered; fixed at registration, never changed; a size-scenario failure sets only its own tests to p = 1 (1.8)

ch212.route_rule: section 4 (counts only, CC9): A if either Mantel-Haenszel odds ratio >= 1.5 or |page difference| >= 0.10; B if >= 30% of listed -> null transitions have clob_dropped; both -> A (B reported); neither -> CH212 dropped

ch215.entry_rule: every CR9 gate passes (section 5); otherwise 'not entered (count)', uncounted, cannot enter later

code_sha_rule: normalised sha256 (SPEC_SHA256 line excluded) of live_tests9.py, live_tests9_analysis.py (phase 2), live_tests9_base.py, bounce_decomp.py and the hashed dependencies panel.py, trade_sample.py, cb17_census.py, cb13_label.py, economics.py, forecast.py, maker_rewards.py (8.1)
f_roles_rule: fixed per test by design (1.9, R1 fix 1), never by a census count; there is no f_binding key; live_tests9.f_role refuses any other value

eligibility.rule: section 1.4: binary, not closed, active, two-sided (0 < bid < ask <= 1) and spread <= 0.10 (Gamma spread, else ask - bid) at the unit's eligibility captures; one row per market_id and per condition_id (first in page order)

sports_rule: cb17_census.is_sports_sidecar(fee_type, fee_category, series_slugs) on the sidecar of the capture; sidecar missing -> sports = -1 (unknown; excluded wherever the category is needed)

crypto_rule.rule: vendored-only: read by the copied category_cols; LT9 classifies crypto with crypto_classifier (the crypto7 class), never with this rule

series_key_rule: first series slug if present, else 'event:' + event_id; crypto rows without a slug -> 'crypto:noslug'

move.class_rule: LT3's class and geometry (vendored; read by the copied _movers_join; no LT9 primary uses the class)

crypto_classifier.rule: 1.4: every primary excludes crypto by this classifier; unknown is counted separately and treated as crypto; the crypto arm is reported, uncounted
crypto_classifier.failsafe: if no distinct fee_category value of the whole sealed sidecar set contains 'crypto' the classifier is not shown to work and the census is refused (every gate NaN)

reward_rule.rule: LT8's null taxonomy (vendored live_tests8.reward_detail: unset / empty_list / zero / rewarded / malformed / no_sidecar / no_column) in the LT7 vocabulary (listed / null / malformed / absent / no_column), then listed_carry24h_v2 (LIVE_TESTS_7.md 13.7 and its erratum; the vendored RewardCarry, fed with LT8's rw frame of EVERY sidecar row): a null clob_rewards at capture j is rewarded = 1 when a LISTED text of [j - 11, j] re-parsed for day(j) gives a rate > 0 (latest such capture = the source, whose rewards_min_size / rewards_max_spread the unit takes); missing slots skipped and counted; nothing after j read; listed-inactive 0; malformed / absent / no_column NaN (excluded, counted)
reward_rule.carry_lag_rule: carry_lag_j = j - the source's slot (0 when listed with a positive rate at j); om_j = 1[carry_lag_j >= 1] among rewarded units (CH212's state; 1.4.1)
reward_rule.ft_both_rule: CH214 control: both bid_size_1 and ask_size_1 of sweep k - 1 <= 1.05 x the source's rewards_min_size (LT8's factor); NaN when a size or the minimum is missing

member_cap.rule: n_members(e, j) = distinct markets of Gamma event e among capture j's complete rows that are binary, open and active (j = k for CH213 and CH212, k - 1 for CH214); a market without event_id is its own event; the primary keeps n_members <= 10, the ladder arm is reported, uncounted

feed.usable_rule: a feed capture is usable only if its manifest state is complete and its rows file exists; a unit whose eligibility capture is j reads the last usable feed capture whose manifest finish is earlier than capture j's manifest start (1.2)
feed.listed_rule: listed = the condition_id appears in the native or the sponsored feed of that capture; a positive configuration = an entry of rewards_config with rate_per_day > 0
feed.end_parse_rule: 1.2 (re-check fix 3): offset timestamp = that instant in UTC; no offset = UTC; date-only YYYY-MM-DD covers [D 00:00Z, D + 1 00:00Z) (end_date_only); absent / null / empty = open-ended; year >= 2100 = sentinel (open-ended, end_sentinel); anything else, including < 2020-01-01, malformed (NaN). CH212 route A and CH215 take the EARLIEST consistent instant (date-only D at D 00:00Z)
feed.no_positive_config_rule: a listed market with no positive-rate configuration has no feed-listed end: route A's end rule is NaN (excluded, counted feed_no_positive_config); a census convention for the freeze check

CH213.panel_rule: panel_m = rewarded_k at the market's first unit (every other filter passed, the band filter of its status included); later opposite-status units excluded (panel_switched)
CH213.break_rule: break_k = 1[s_{k-1} < 2v and s_k >= 2v], s = ask - bid in cents, tolerance 1e-9 c
CH213.first_origin_rule: first capture whose capture k - 1 starts at or after REGISTERED_UTC (2027-01-21T02:31Z as proposed); the 00:31Z capture is lt8_boundary

CH214.split_rule: zdD+ = max(0, dD) / scale_census, zdD- = min(0, dD) / scale_census (split at zero change, never centred; re-check fix 2); the centred zdD only for S2 and the census gates
CH214.first_origin_rule: first unit whose pass k - 2 sweep starts at or after REGISTERED_UTC; earlier ones lt8_boundary

CH212.end_rule: route A: the latest end among the market's positive configurations in the SAME feed capture (each at its earliest consistent instant) later than grid0 + 2 h x (k + 2); open-ended / sentinel qualifies (feed_end_open); malformed NaN (feed_end_malformed); earlier excluded (feed_end_soon)

CH215.census_decision_rule: census convention: the decision is the first SEALED usable feed capture listing the end whose finish is <= T_e - 48 h (the window reader uses every feed capture since the feed's start, 8.1); the decision capture is the last sealed capture whose LAST ROW RECEIPT is strictly before that finish (1.3 strictly earlier; code check 2026-10-23 must-fix 2)
CH215.control_rule: up to 3 reward-panel markets (carry at the decision capture) in the same (category, tier, tick) cell, eligible at the decision capture, with no listed positive end within [T_e - 72 h, T_e + 72 h] at the decision feed capture, nearest |log liquidity| first (ties condition_id, section 5; code check 2026-10-23 must-fix 4); reuse ban across ends whose [T_e - 48 h, T_e) spans overlap, greedy in decision-time order over already-decided ends only (re-check fix 1)

seeds.derived_rule: non-binding runs on generators 20261197 x 100 + n (1.8.1)

gates.perm_method: block circular-shift Freedman-Lane for CH213, CH214, CH212; sign-flip by CH215 cluster (2,000 draws) for CH215

inference.p_rule: p = max(p_event on t with G_event - 1 df, p_two-way normal, p_day on t with G_day - 1 df); CH213 and CH212 event df use min(G_event, G_minor) - 1

size_check.rule: phase 2; a failing binding scenario sets only its own tests to 'SE check failed' with k unchanged; s12 evaluated only when ch215.entered; s04r never binding; world 8 reads p_vm = max(CS9 vnum_missing share of CH214's primary units, 0.50)

census_inputs.lt9_seal_note: written by run_live_tests9.py seal (q0641) after the design-text freeze and after the span has ended; committed before any LT9 census
census_inputs.window_rule: captures from 12 slots before the span to 2 slots after it (the last lag passes' token keys and capture k's start of CH214's last origins); sweeps from 2 passes before to 2 passes after; feed captures starting in [span start - 26 h, the sealed bound); origins are the span's slots
census_inputs.covered_days_rule: covered origins / 12 (CC9: span slots with captures k - 1 and k sealed; CS9: span slots with captures k - 2, k - 1, k and sweeps k - 2, k - 1 sealed; F pairs: CS9 origins with sweeps k + 2, k + 3 also sealed; CR9: span slots of [start + 48 h, end) holding a usable feed capture); below the minimum every gate of that census is NaN and fails
census_inputs.cs9_not_before_rule: CS9 runs only after T_E022 (R1 should-fix); the runner refuses before E022's proposed analysis date, and the orchestrator confirms T_E022 from the queue log / commit; if CS9 starts before T_E022, CH214 carries informed (E022)
census_inputs.projection: counts x 21 / covered days; distinct events: events x 21 / covered days (gated) and E_all + (E_all - E_day1) x (21 - covered_days) (printed)
census_inputs.count_gate_rule: gross projected counts after every filter of the test (panel_switched, touch_out_of_band, feed_end_soon included), before the census-fixed family exclusion, no 0.8 factor; the declared MDE uses the effective counts (markets with >= 2 units)

lag_loader.CH213: captures k + 4, k + 5: market_id, best_bid, best_ask reduced to the spread and compared with 2v inside the loader; the twin break flag only; a control unit's v is v_ctrl of capture k + 5's cell, a reward unit's the same v. Capture k + 5's cell MEMBERSHIP uses its 1.4 eligibility at k + 5 (bid, ask, mid, end), computed in the streaming loop; only (n, median v) per cell reach lag_twin_flags; only the flag reaches the unit frame (code check 2026-10-23 must-fix 3 and re-check item 2)
lag_loader.CH214: sweeps k + 2, k + 3: market_id, token_id and depth_bid_1c, depth_ask_1c, depth_bid_5c, depth_ask_5c; the capture's market_id, clob_token_id_0
lag_loader.CH212: the carry status om of capture k + 4 only

mde_common.rule: every MDE gate is max(declared, design) (7); declared = the closed formula at the census's own effective counts, DE_gate, VIF_w (and gap) with the declared SD; design = 3.47 x 1.5 x SD x se_1 under a working covariance (unit variance, within-event equicorrelation 0.02, independence across events), projected to 21 days; F-MDE = max(design-based MDE of Delta in the arm model, MDE x sqrt(2 / (1 - max(0, r_gate)))); NaN fails; DE_gate = max(floor, 1 + (m_21 - 1) x 0.02); t_sum = max(3.47, exact)

prior_population_specs.source: restated from live_tests8_v1.json / live_tests7_v1.json values for the vendored quiet_units / patient_units (a unit test checks them against those files); read by no gate

test.quiet_rule: |smid_{k-1} - smid_{k-2}| < 0.005 and |mid_k - smid_{k-1}| < 0.005 (strict; the comparison uses 0.005 - 1e-9 so that a half-tick change of exactly 0.005 is never quiet through float noise)
test.first_origin_rule: first capture whose pass k - 2 sweep starts at or after REGISTERED_UTC (12-30T04:31Z as proposed; the 00:31Z and 02:31Z origins are lt7_boundary)

declared_before_seal.source: docs/research_lab/reviews/LT9_CENSUS_CODE_CHECK_2026-10-23.md (rulings and notes); declared before the LT9 seal and any census, no data read

end_kind_precedence.rule: malformed > open > dated: any malformed positive configuration makes the market NaN for CH212's feed end rule and excludes its dated ends from CR9; a market with open-ended or sentinel and no malformed configuration is open; else dated. Mixed cases (malformed together with another kind) are counted (malformed_mixed_markets).
end_kind_precedence.reason: ruling 1 of the code check: the text does not settle malformed plus dated; the minimal conservative choice

sentinel_year.rule: the year as written in the value (before any UTC conversion) is compared with 2100
sentinel_year.reason: ruling 2: the text says a value with year >= 2100; matters only within about 14 h of 2100-01-01, so no census count can change

end_kind_denominators.CC9: positive-rate configurations of every sealed usable feed capture read by the census, each capture counted once
end_kind_denominators.CR9: positive-rate configurations of the sealed usable feed captures from the first sealed capture's start on, each capture counted once; CR9 prints its positive-config count
end_kind_denominators.CH212_feed_end_shares: units of the capped, family-excluded CH212 population whose market is listed in the feed capture; feed_unlisted (ghost) units are excluded from the shares
end_kind_denominators.reason: ruling 3: the text fixes no denominator; both are descriptives

switching_gate_mean_per_day.rule: mean over the span's UTC days of the number of markets with both a null and a listed clob_rewards status among ALL sidecar rows of the day's span captures (no eligibility, category or cap filter)
switching_gate_mean_per_day.reason: code check note: the gate's mean-per-day definition is declared before the seal
